visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look) + Solid Flat forms. No soft drop shadows. Use 1px sharp borders or brutalist solid shadows to represent official, physical documentation.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay on the background to make it feel like official paper/land deeds.
visual_enhancers.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for marketing, Regular for dashboard)

layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.
layouts.marketing_page: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetric bento grid for features. Massive typography. Hero section overlapping map interface.
layouts.dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid. Strict grid hierarchy, 1px borders between widgets (border-collapse look). Sidebar nav.
layouts.map_view: Split Screen layout: Map takes 60% of viewport width on desktop (sticky right), list view scrolls on the left 40%. Mobile: Map is 40vh at top, list below.
layouts.forms: Multi-step forms for land transactions. Left aligned labels, dense but clear layout, clear validation states.

motion.hover_states: Hard translations (hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary). Explicitly change text colors on hover.
motion.map_interactions: Smooth fly-to animations when clicking a land parcel in the list.
motion.micro_interactions: Checkboxes and toggles have a snappy, mechanical feel.

component_guidelines.buttons: Flat, sharp edges. Primary uses Forest Green, Secondary uses Sage. Use solid shadows.
component_guidelines.cards: Cardless approach or 1px border cards. No soft standard shadows. Sharp edges.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn standard but rounded-none. border-border focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent.
component_guidelines.dialogs: Crystal Glassmorphism backdrop (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md). Solid white modal with sharp edges.
component_guidelines.tables: Grid Borders style. border-collapse. Highly readable, generous padding.
component_guidelines.maps: React Map GL. Custom Mapbox style in light mode (streets/satellite toggle) with custom GeoJSON polygon layers for plots. Use #D95A2B with 0.4 opacity for land polygons.

images.description: Scenic view of Guinea landscape, representing the land being sold/managed. Use with an overlay.
Detailed map of an urban area. Use as placeholder if Mapbox is loading or for feature graphics.
Green trees and landscape. Use as default image for land plots.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure >4.5:1 contrast for text. Primary #133E26 on #F7F7F5 is very high contrast (WCAG AAA).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid="login-submit-btn"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React JS (.js/.jsx) syntax. Do not use TypeScript.
Ensure `react-map-gl` is installed and implemented correctly for the map interface.
Use `i18next` or a simple context for the French/English bilingual requirement. Default to French.
For the dashboard, use the 'Grid Borders' layout approach (sharp 1px lines, no shadows) to create an 'official registry' feel.
Implement Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to remove the default rounded Vercel look. Use sharp corners and solid shadows.
Make sure all map plots have a hover state and display a tooltip or popup with property details.
Follow the defined color palette rigorously. Do not use generic Tailwind colors like blue-500 or gray-200. Map them to the custom CSS variables.
Implement the split-screen layout for the main map view on desktop (60% map right, 40% list left).
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating headers/navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Components MUST use named exports. Pages MUST use default exports.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
